description: This file is a PHP unit test class 'LocalizationServiceTest' for testing the 'LocalizationService' component in the OrangeHRM system. It includes multiple test methods that verify the functionality of localization features such as date formats, language support, language exporting, XLIFF processing, error handling, and validation of localization strings.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class testing various functionalities of the LocalizationService in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by instantiating LocalizationService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of date formats provided by the localization service.

methods.name: testGetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Checks if supported languages array matches expected values.

methods.description: Tests search functionality for languages using DAO mock.

methods.description: Validates retrieval of language array with language name and code.

methods.description: Tests the generation of language keys based on IDs.

methods.description: Ensures language packages can be exported correctly.

methods.name: testGetXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Verifies XLIFF XML export generates expected XML structure and content.
